# Model Artifact Test Fixtures

This directory contains minimal, deterministic binary fixtures used for sub-second, zero-network unit testing across AI model inspection formats:

1. **`tiny.gguf`**:
   - Format: GGUF v3
   - Architecture: `tiny_transformer`
   - Tensor Count: 2 (`blk.0.attn_q.weight`, `blk.0.ffn_down.weight`)
   - Context Length: 512
   - Generated by: `mcp-server/scripts/utils/generate_model_fixtures.py`

2. **`tiny.pt`**:
   - Format: PyTorch ZIP archive checkpoint
   - Contents: `archive/data.pkl` (state_dict metadata), `archive/data/0` (storage record)
   - Metadata: epoch 14, best_fitness 0.892, task `detect`, classes (`ball`, `player`, `referee`)
   - Modeled after real YOLOv8 models from [`djmahe4/footydj_mini_project/models`](https://github.com/djmahe4/footydj_mini_project/tree/main/models)

3. **`tiny.onnx`**:
   - Format: ONNX ModelProto binary protobuf
   - IR Version: 8, Producer: `model_inspector_test`, Opset: 17

## Real Artifact Reference
For integration smoke validation and deep reverse engineering benchmarks, real-world YOLOv8 PyTorch checkpoints are indexed from:
- `https://github.com/djmahe4/footydj_mini_project/tree/main/models`
  - `best7.pt` (90MB, custom trained YOLOv8 model)
  - `yolov8m_ball_60e_1280.pt` (52MB, football detection weights)
  - `pitch_640_14e.pt` (92MB, pitch segmentation weights)
  - `player_512_30e_robo.pt` / `player_512_80e.pt` (52MB, player keypoint/detection weights)

4. **`tiny_cnn.pt`**:
   - Format: PyTorch ZIP archive with a real `state_dict` (two convolutions with batch norm, one linear layer, 1,491 parameters)
   - Task `classify`, classes (`ball`, `player`, `referee`)
   - Generated by `generate_tiny_cnn_pt` in `generate_model_fixtures.py`; skipped when PyTorch is not installed. Used by the ML Learning dashboard to follow an image through real layers.
